role: Transparent native Blender homepage instrument master
meaning: A catalog collator holds two banks of separately spaced, indexed metal leaves around one copper resolved leaf. Engraved message rows, varied index tabs, a central keyed alignment channel, registration comb, screw adjuster, and open bank cradles express matching catalog entries and preserving an authoritative correction. Detailed machined construction, actual recessed marks, separate fasteners, brushed polished steel, dark red-brown granular corrosion islands with broken oxide rims, pitted normal relief and dull oxidized metal between crusts, graphite interiors, directional softbox reflections, and genuine transparent negative space.
